tools.name: freshdesk_list_tickets
tools.description: List/filter tickets (max page 300). Freshdesk REST: GET /tickets.

tools.name: freshdesk_get_ticket
tools.description: Get a single ticket by id. Freshdesk REST: GET /tickets/{id}.

tools.name: freshdesk_search_tickets
tools.description: Filter tickets with the Freshdesk query language. Only these fields work: agent_id, group_id, priority, status, tag, type, due_by, fr_due_by, created_at, updated_at, closed_at, and custom fields by name. There is no subject or text search; for a requester or company use freshdesk_list_tickets (reque

tools.name: freshdesk_list_ticket_conversations
tools.description: List the conversations (replies and notes) on a ticket. Freshdesk REST: GET /tickets/{id}/conversations.

tools.name: freshdesk_list_contacts
tools.description: List/filter contacts. Freshdesk REST: GET /contacts.

tools.name: freshdesk_get_contact
tools.description: Get a single contact by id. Freshdesk REST: GET /contacts/{id}.

tools.name: freshdesk_search_contacts
tools.description: Filter contacts with the Freshdesk query language. Only these fields work: active, company_id, twitter_id, email, phone, mobile, tag, language, time_zone, created_at, updated_at, and custom fields by name. There is no name search. The query VALUE is wrapped in double quotes automatically. Examples:

tools.name: freshdesk_list_companies
tools.description: List companies. Freshdesk REST: GET /companies.

tools.name: freshdesk_get_company
tools.description: Get a single company by id. Freshdesk REST: GET /companies/{id}.

tools.name: freshdesk_list_agents
tools.description: List/filter agents. Freshdesk REST: GET /agents.

tools.name: freshdesk_get_agent
tools.description: Get a single agent by id. Freshdesk REST: GET /agents/{id}.

tools.name: freshdesk_list_groups
tools.description: List groups (agent groups tickets are routed to). Freshdesk REST: GET /groups.

tools.name: freshdesk_create_ticket
tools.description: Create a ticket. `subject` and `description` (HTML) are required, plus a requester — provide at least one of `email`, `requester_id`, or `phone`. status: 2=Open, 3=Pending, 4=Resolved, 5=Closed. priority: 1=Low, 2=Medium, 3=High, 4=Urgent. source: 1=Email, 2=Portal, 3=Phone, 7=Chat, 9=Feedbackwidget

tools.name: freshdesk_update_ticket
tools.description: Update fields on an existing ticket. Only provided fields are changed. status: 2=Open, 3=Pending, 4=Resolved, 5=Closed. priority: 1=Low, 2=Medium, 3=High, 4=Urgent. Freshdesk REST: PUT /tickets/{id}.

tools.name: freshdesk_reply_ticket
tools.description: Add a public reply to a ticket (sent to the requester). Freshdesk REST: POST /tickets/{id}/reply.

tools.name: freshdesk_add_note
tools.description: Add a note to a ticket. Notes are internal (private) by default; set `private: false` for a public note. Freshdesk REST: POST /tickets/{id}/notes.

tools.name: freshdesk_create_contact
tools.description: Create a contact. `name` is required. Freshdesk REST: POST /contacts.

tools.name: freshdesk_update_contact
tools.description: Update fields on an existing contact. Only provided fields are changed. Freshdesk REST: PUT /contacts/{id}.

tools.name: freshdesk_create_company
tools.description: Create a company. `name` is required. Freshdesk REST: POST /companies.

tools.name: freshdesk_bulk_update_tickets
tools.description: Set the same properties on up to 100 tickets in one request (status, priority, type, group, agent, source, product), and optionally add the same public reply to each. Freshdesk runs it as a background job: the reply has a job_id; check it with freshdesk_get_job. Freshdesk REST: POST /tickets/bulk_up

tools.name: freshdesk_get_job
tools.description: Status and progress of a Freshdesk background job, e.g. a bulk ticket update (for example "IN PROGRESS" until it ends). Freshdesk REST: GET /jobs/{id}.

tools.name: freshdesk_forward_ticket
tools.description: Forward a ticket to external email addresses (sends an email). Freshdesk REST: POST /tickets/{id}/forward.

tools.name: freshdesk_merge_tickets
tools.description: Merge duplicate tickets into one primary ticket. The secondary tickets get closed and their conversations move to the primary ticket. This cannot be undone. Freshdesk REST: PUT /tickets/merge.

tools.name: freshdesk_delete_ticket
tools.description: Move a ticket to the trash. freshdesk_restore_ticket brings it back (list trashed tickets with freshdesk_list_tickets filter=deleted). Freshdesk REST: DELETE /tickets/{id}.

tools.name: freshdesk_restore_ticket
tools.description: Restore a ticket from the trash. Freshdesk REST: PUT /tickets/{id}/restore.

tools.name: freshdesk_create_outbound_email
tools.description: Start a new conversation by email: creates an outbound ticket and emails the contact (a new contact is created for an unknown address). By default the ticket is Closed and assigned to you; subject and description cannot be edited later. email_config_id comes from freshdesk_list_email_configs. Freshd

tools.name: freshdesk_list_ticket_fields
tools.description: Ticket fields with their names, labels, types and dropdown choices: the status, priority and type values and the custom field names (cf_...) the other tools take. Freshdesk REST: GET /ticket_fields.

tools.name: freshdesk_list_email_configs
tools.description: Support email addresses (email configs) with their ids, group and product. Freshdesk REST: GET /email_configs.

tools.name: freshdesk_update_note
tools.description: Change the text of a note (public or private) on a ticket. Replies sent to customers cannot be edited. Conversation ids come from freshdesk_list_ticket_conversations. Freshdesk REST: PUT /conversations/{id}.

tools.name: freshdesk_list_time_entries
tools.description: Time logged on tickets. Give ticket_id for one ticket, or filter all entries by agent, company, billable and date. Freshdesk REST: GET /tickets/{id}/time_entries or GET /time_entries.

tools.name: freshdesk_create_time_entry
tools.description: Log time on a ticket. Give time_spent (hh:mm) for finished work; without time_spent a timer starts. One agent can run only one timer. Freshdesk REST: POST /tickets/{id}/time_entries.

tools.name: freshdesk_update_time_entry
tools.description: Change a time entry: time spent, note, billable, agent or date. Freshdesk REST: PUT /time_entries/{id}.

tools.name: freshdesk_toggle_timer
tools.description: Start a stopped timer or stop a running one on a time entry. Freshdesk REST: PUT /time_entries/{id}/toggle_timer.

tools.name: freshdesk_list_satisfaction_ratings
tools.description: Customer satisfaction survey results. Give ticket_id for one ticket, or list all ratings since a date or for one customer. Each rating has agent_id (the responder) and group_id. Freshdesk REST: GET /tickets/{id}/satisfaction_ratings or GET /surveys/satisfaction_ratings.

tools.name: freshdesk_list_surveys
tools.description: Satisfaction surveys with their questions and rating scales (to read rating values). Freshdesk REST: GET /surveys.

tools.name: freshdesk_find_contacts
tools.description: Find contacts by the start of a name word ("joh" finds John Jonz; "hn" does not). Freshdesk REST: GET /contacts/autocomplete.

tools.name: freshdesk_list_contact_fields
tools.description: Contact fields with names, types and choices, incl. custom fields. Freshdesk REST: GET /contact_fields.

tools.name: freshdesk_get_current_agent
tools.description: The agent that owns this API key: id, email, role, groups, ticket scope. Freshdesk REST: GET /agents/me.

tools.name: freshdesk_find_agents
tools.description: Find agents by the start of a name or email word. Freshdesk REST: GET /agents/autocomplete.

tools.name: freshdesk_create_agent
tools.description: Invite a new agent (admin only; may use a paid seat). Freshdesk REST: POST /agents.

tools.name: freshdesk_update_agent
tools.description: Change an agent's ticket scope, groups, roles, skills, signature, language or time zone (admin only). Name, phone and job title cannot change through the API. Arrays replace the list. Freshdesk REST: PUT /agents/{id}.

tools.name: freshdesk_list_roles
tools.description: Agent roles (Agent, Supervisor, Admin ...) with ids for freshdesk_create_agent. Freshdesk REST: GET /roles.

tools.name: freshdesk_get_group
tools.description: One group with its agents, escalation and assignment settings. Freshdesk REST: GET /groups/{id}.

tools.name: freshdesk_create_group
tools.description: Create an agent group (admin only). Freshdesk REST: POST /groups.

tools.name: freshdesk_update_group
tools.description: Rename a group or change its agents and escalation (admin only). agent_ids replaces the member list. Freshdesk REST: PUT /groups/{id}.

tools.name: freshdesk_find_companies
tools.description: Find companies by the start of a name word ("acme" or "corp" finds Acme Corporation). Freshdesk REST: GET /companies/autocomplete.

tools.name: freshdesk_search_companies
tools.description: Filter companies with the Freshdesk query language on domain, created_at, updated_at and custom company fields (names from freshdesk_list_company_fields). The query is wrapped in double quotes for you. Examples: `domain:'acme.com'`, `created_at:>'2026-01-01'`. 30 per page, pages 1-10. Freshdesk REST

tools.name: freshdesk_list_company_fields
tools.description: Company fields with names, types and choices, incl. custom fields. Freshdesk REST: GET /company_fields.

tools.name: freshdesk_update_company
tools.description: Change a company's name, domains, description, note, health score, account tier, renewal date, industry or custom fields. domains REPLACES the list ([] removes all). Freshdesk REST: PUT /companies/{id}.

tools.name: freshdesk_list_canned_response_folders
tools.description: Folders of canned (saved) replies with counts. Freshdesk REST: GET /canned_response_folders.

tools.name: freshdesk_list_canned_responses
tools.description: The canned replies in one folder, with their full text. Freshdesk REST: GET /canned_response_folders/{id}/responses.

tools.name: freshdesk_get_canned_response
tools.description: One canned reply with its HTML text. Freshdesk REST: GET /canned_responses/{id}.

tools.name: freshdesk_create_canned_response
tools.description: Save a reusable reply. Freshdesk REST: POST /canned_responses.

tools.name: freshdesk_search_solution_articles
tools.description: Search knowledge-base (solution) articles by keyword. Freshdesk REST: GET /search/solutions.

tools.name: freshdesk_list_solution_categories
tools.description: Knowledge-base categories. Freshdesk REST: GET /solutions/categories.

tools.name: freshdesk_create_solution_category
tools.description: Create a knowledge-base category. Freshdesk REST: POST /solutions/categories.

tools.name: freshdesk_list_solution_folders
tools.description: Folders in a knowledge-base category, or the subfolders of a folder. Freshdesk REST: GET /solutions/categories/{id}/folders or GET /solutions/folders/{id}/subfolders.

tools.name: freshdesk_create_solution_folder
tools.description: Create a folder in a knowledge-base category. visibility: 1 all users, 2 logged-in users, 3 agents, 4 selected companies, 5 bots, 6 selected contact segments, 7 selected company segments. Freshdesk REST: POST /solutions/categories/{id}/folders.

tools.name: freshdesk_list_solution_articles
tools.description: Articles in a knowledge-base folder. Freshdesk REST: GET /solutions/folders/{id}/articles.

tools.name: freshdesk_get_solution_article
tools.description: One knowledge-base article with its full text. Freshdesk REST: GET /solutions/articles/{id}.

tools.name: freshdesk_create_solution_article
tools.description: Write a new knowledge-base article in a folder, as a draft (status 1) or published (status 2). Freshdesk REST: POST /solutions/folders/{id}/articles.

tools.name: freshdesk_update_solution_article
tools.description: Edit a knowledge-base article: title, text, status (1 draft, 2 published), tags, author. tags replaces the list. Freshdesk REST: PUT /solutions/articles/{id}.

tools.name: freshdesk_list_products
tools.description: Products (brands) with their ids. Freshdesk REST: GET /products.

tools.name: freshdesk_list_sla_policies
tools.description: SLA policies with response and resolution targets per priority. Freshdesk REST: GET /sla_policies.

tools.name: freshdesk_list_business_hours
tools.description: Business hours calendars with time zone and working hours. Freshdesk REST: GET /business_hours.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: freshdesk_list_tickets, freshdesk_get_ticket, freshdesk_search_tickets, freshdesk_list_ticket_conversations, freshdesk_search_contacts, freshdesk_list_groups, freshdesk_create_ticket, freshdesk_update_ticket, freshdesk_bulk_update_tickets, freshdesk_get_job, freshdesk_merge_tickets, freshdesk_delete_ticket, freshdesk_list_ticket_fields, freshdesk_list_email_configs, freshdesk_list_time_entries, freshdesk_list_satisfaction_ratings, freshdesk_get_current_agent, freshdesk_find_agents, freshdesk_update_agent, freshdesk_get_canned_response · Private data: freshdesk_list_contacts, freshdesk_get_contact, freshdesk_search_contacts, freshdesk_add_note, freshdesk_create_contact, freshdesk_update_contact, freshdesk_create_outbound_email, freshdesk_update_note, freshdesk_find_contacts, freshdesk_list_contact_fields, freshdesk_get_current_agent, freshdesk_create_solution_folder · Public sink: freshdesk_search_tickets, freshdesk_search_contacts, freshdesk_create_ticket, freshdesk_reply_ticket, freshdesk_add_note, freshdesk_create_contact, freshdesk_create_company, freshdesk_bulk_update_tickets, freshdesk_forward_ticket, freshdesk_create_outbound_email, freshdesk_list_email_configs, freshdesk_create_time_entry, freshdesk_get_current_agent, freshdesk_find_agents, freshdesk_create_agent, freshdesk_create_group, freshdesk_create_canned_response, freshdesk_create_solution_category, freshdesk_create_solution_folder, freshdesk_create_solution_article · Destructive: freshdesk_delete_ticket, freshdesk_create_time_entry.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
